description: Capabilities the main window holds on Android and iOS only. The barcode scanner and the biometric sensor exist on no desktop platform, so granting them here keeps a desktop build from referencing permissions it has no plugin for. The biometric permission is the one capability the webview genuinely needs: the lock screen is a screen, so it asks. What it can do with a success is call `unlock`, which is a flag the Rust side owns and every dial consults.
